subject: ivy-emberose
label: Four years underground, alone, in the dark
from: An unfiled theory about humming, which the Archive named as a guess and refused to build on
to: IVY SPENT FOUR YEARS UNDERGROUND BY HERSELF IN THE DARK. The humming is ECHOLOCATION
note:
THE ARCHIVE HELD THIS ONE OPEN AND IT WAS RIGHT TO. It had noticed the humming. It had noticed that Harley Calder — who moves without sound, who materialises three inches behind people in dark kitchens, who has startled every other woman on this compound — HAS NEVER ONCE STARTLED IVY. It named the connection aloud as a GUESS and declined to file it.

THE REASON IS FAR WORSE THAN THE THEORY. Ivy Serene Emberose, 06-203, Porcelain Dolls, SPENT FOUR YEARS UNDERGROUND, ALONE, IN THE DARK. And she learned to hum, and the hum comes back off the walls, and she has been reading rooms by their returns ever since.

SHE IS NOT LISTENING FOR HARLEY. SHE IS LISTENING TO THE ROOM, ALL OF IT, ALL THE TIME, and Harley is simply a shape the room has in it.

WHAT THE FAMILY HEARS IS A WOMAN IN A SWOOSHY DRESS HUMMING TO HERSELF IN A CARROT ROW FOR FOUR HOURS A DAY ACROSS EIGHTY-EIGHT ACRES. What it actually is: a survival adaptation from a hole in the ground, running continuously, in sunlight, in a garden she owns, for the rest of her life.

AND EVIE WENT DOWN INTO JONAH'S DEPTHS ALONE TO GET HER OUT. The Tunnel Rescue is in Evie's own profile. That is where she went.
